title: But his hands were bluish with cold
html_source: Here is another point of how cold the environment Stephen thinks this place is. he always uses the color white when it comes to describing the walls indoors. In this case he throws readers off using the color blue.

anchor.prefix:
had answered:

 —A gentleman.

 Then Nasty Roche had asked:

 —Is he a magistrate?

 He crept about from point to point on the fringe of his line, making little runs now and then.
